name: Pipeline Repair
description: Diagnose an incident, perform an authorized bounded repair, wait durably for the provider, and verify recovery with an incident report.
when_to_use: Use when a data pipeline or external processing job needs evidence-based diagnosis, controlled repair, and verification of live operation and backlog.

stages.title: Capture incident and diagnose: {goal}
stages.description: Capture incident state and diagnose {goal}. Separate symptoms, supported root causes, mitigation, and repair options. Record the observed configuration or deployment revision and environment. Gather evidence before proposing an external action; use `{test_command}` where it helps reproduce the failing boundary.
acceptance: Incident timeline and failing boundary are supported by observations

stages.title: Perform bounded repair: {goal}
stages.description: Perform the bounded repair within the mission's recorded authority. Request a durable confirmation only when required authority or scope is missing; honor answers already given. Before an external change use effect prepare/start with the exact target and provider key, then record or reconcile the provider receipt. Represent long provider jobs with a durable external wait. Register a checkout only if source edits are needed. Record the resulting configuration revision, verification command `{test_command}`, and rollback instructions.
acceptance: Repair or mitigation has current authority, effect receipts, and rollback instructions

stages.title: Observe healthy operation: {goal}
stages.description: Independently observe the resulting configuration and enough completed provider runs to verify recovery, then run `{test_command}`. Use a new durable wait if more observations are needed. Verify both live operation and the disposition of the backlog. Do not edit the repair. Distinguish restored, mitigated, and still blocked outcomes; a signal or elapsed wait is not proof of success.
acceptance: Healthy runs and backlog disposition are verified on the exact resulting configuration

stages.title: Explain incident and result: {goal}
stages.description: Use why and export to produce a factual postmortem for {goal}. Label hypotheses and unresolved causes.
acceptance: Postmortem cites the timeline, attempts, effects, verification, and remaining work
